records.rule: Canonical website startup is ./flylo; hide runtime plumbing behind the launcher.
Grok produces structured proposals; deterministic FlyLo orchestration decides airline operations.
passengerCount and passengers are different facts and must never share one field contract.
Passenger servicing binds to stable PAX semantic identities and exact workspace context.
Booking/passenger/inventory and accounting state must survive launcher restart together.
Booking-not-found and similar engine rejections are domain results, not ooRexx runtime conditions.
Payment authorisation alone posts nothing; explicit capture emits normalized accounting evidence and accounting remains separate from booking authority.
Consume shared Wire UI row/list/filter/sort functionality; do not maintain a private FlyLo list framework.
On a new TK5 validation host, inventory exact installed devices, PROCs and PGM identities before loading FlyLo.
Use one planned 3270 session at a time. After HERC01 login the blank screen is the TSO command environment, not a hang.
Preserve failing evidence and diagnose one failed attempt before changing source or JCL.
Operational path validity, commercial validity, ticket coupon validity, baggage authority and cargo operator authority are distinct facts.
